selected.title: He Turned Our Fights Into a Group Chat Series
selected.hook: My boyfriend turned our private arguments into entertainment for his friends.
selected.voiceover:
My boyfriend turned our private arguments into entertainment for his friends.

We'd been together for almost two years, and I always thought one thing we did well was keep our problems between us. We could fight, cool off, talk it through, and move on.

Then his phone buzzed while we were watching a movie.

The preview said, "Episode 12: she's mad again."

I laughed because I assumed it was some stupid group chat joke.

Then I opened it.

He had a chat with four of his friends where he'd been posting screenshots of our texts, voice notes about our fights, and little summaries with titles like "The Dishwasher War" and "Date Night Disaster."

They were reacting with memes and voting on who was "right."

One of them even wrote, "Tell us what she says next."

I felt sick.

He grabbed the phone and said they were just helping him get perspective, and that everyone vents to friends.

But this wasn't venting.

It was a running commentary on our relationship.

There were messages from arguments I'd cried over, turned into jokes before we'd even made up.

Now he says I'm overreacting because none of his friends actually dislike me, and he never shared anything intimate.

I don't care.

If every vulnerable moment can become content for your group chat, how am I supposed to feel safe being honest with you again?
